lg.l: Heraclite fleas, misero sic convenit aevo,
Nil nisi turpe vides, nil nisi triste vides.
Ride etiam, quantumque lubet, Democrite ride
Non nisi vana vides, non nisi stulta vides.
In fletu, hic risu modo gaudeat, unus utrique
Sit licet usque labor, sit licet usque dolor.
Nunc opus est (nam totus eheu jam desipit orbis)
Mille Heraclitis, milleque Democritis.
Nunc opus est (tanta est insania) transeat omnis
Mundus in Anticyras, gramen in Helleborum.
You should weep, Heraclitus: that suits this wretched age,
You see nothing but the foul, nothing but the sorrowful.
And yet laugh as much as you like, Democritus, laugh:
You see nothing but the vain, nothing but the foolish.
Let one take pleasure in tears, the other in laughter,
Each has the same everlasting burden, each the same everlasting pain.
Now there’s need (for the whole world, alas, is now mad)
For a thousand Heraclituses, a thousand Democrituses.
Now there’s need (the madness is so great) for the whole world
To become Anticyra, for every plant to become hellebore.
